description: This file defines several Odoo models and database views related to reporting on document attachments, user activity, partner associations, and inactivity within the report_document module.

classes.name: report_document_user
classes.description: Model representing file details grouped by users, backed by a database view.

classes.name: report_files_partner
classes.description: Model representing file details grouped by partners, backed by a database view.

classes.name: report_document_file
classes.description: Model representing file details grouped by directory and month, backed by a database view.

classes.name: report_document_wall
classes.description: Model representing users who have not posted documents in over a month, backed by a database view.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database views for each report model by executing raw SQL CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW statements.
